protocol.warmup: 3 uncounted flush() passes at the start and 3 uncounted observe() writes before the measured observe samples; the backlog scenarios are not warmed up separately (they follow the same fixture in sequence)
protocol.aggregation: one process per side per round; per scenario the three per-round medians (each of 9 samples) are reduced by their median

durableStateDigest.normalized: only this run's own root directory (recorded as the staging path of a cold archive segment) is replaced before hashing

checkpointContentDigest.normalized: file.dev/file.ino and the MAC that covers them; every other field is content
